cmd:
stat -c '%y' /opt/trading-bot/positions_regr/tg_regime_cfg.json; python3 -c "
import json,collections
ps=json.load(open('/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr/positions.json'))
om={o['id']:o for o in json.load(open('/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr/orders.json'))}
g=collections.defaultdict(list)
for p in ps:
    if p['status']!='closed' or p.get('src')!='chan': continue
    o=om.get(p.get('order_id')) or {}; rg=(o.get('regime') or {}).get('regime')
    if not rg: continue
    ok = (p['side']=='short')==(rg=='down') if rg!='flat' else None
    g[(rg,p['side'],o.get('setup'))].append(p)
for k,v in sorted(g.items(),key=str):
    print(k,'n',len(v),'win',sum(1 for x in v if (x.get('net_pct') or 0)>0),'net %.2f'%sum(x.get('net_pct') or 0 for x in v),'ids',[x['id'] for x in v][-10:])
" | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'; grep -n -i "filter\|regime_cfg" /dev/null
